svg.text: 4 strips 40 × 22, laid flat · plan view, front at the bottom
top face 330 below the box top, glued to all four walls
6 × Ø6.5 × 13 for M5 inserts, on Ø250
As on the datasheet: holes at 3 and 9 o'clock,
Both sides identical: centre 153 from either
All from one 2000 × 1000 board (cutting plan in the build guide).
Measure the OSB: inside sizes are outside − 2 × thickness.
Order: recess (router + circle jig), inserts, then the cutout.
Rout a test recess in scrap and drop a driver in first.
Size 20 (56 × 23 × 4), slots centred in the 22 mm thickness.
Plates onto sides: 6 per 530 edge at 45 / 133 / 221 / 309 / 397 / 485.
Plates onto top/bottom: 3 per edge at 70 / 170 / 270 from the plate
Sides onto top/bottom ends: 3 per edge at 50 / 153 / 256.
Recess edge is 19.5 mm from the side's edges: the 530-edge slots
are clear of it, the recess is only 4.5 deep.
OSB: reference the joiner from the face, not the fence; check
every slot for voids. No lacquer on glue faces or in the slots.
Braces: glue only, clamped; they are short and fully supported.
biscuit slot, size 20 (56 × 23 × 4), centred in the 22 mm edge
hidden edge / glue line of a brace
sealed, ≈ 40 l net · 2 × SB Acoustics SB26SFCL38-4, opposed · companion to Le Petit
22 mm OSB · biscuits (size 20) + wood glue · glued shut, drivers from outside
